merge.test_zone_note: User-surveyed MORAI waypoint ranges: roundabout 1770-1820, merge1 2480-2560, merge2 3050-3190.
merge.observation_note: ONLY left-side UDP9293 plus an independently configured rear-left-facing camera; right-side UDP9295 MUST NOT be bound, decoded, previewed, or used for merge decisions. Rear-left port is unknown in provided official 3-camera sensor-set: configure after MORAI verification. Unconfigured rear-left camera blocks merge worker launch (fail closed). Camera risk is image-space and not calibrated TTC.
merge.perception_tuning_note: Roundabout WP1770-1820: use LEFT9293 only and ignore rear-left1118. Highway merge WP2480-2560 and WP3050-3190: use LEFT9293 + LEFT_REAR1118. Original V23 risk threshold 0.60 and near-vehicle risk function unchanged. Very small far-looking bboxes attenuated by area ratio; not a calibrated range or lane-ID model.
merge.post_merge_note: Only for first highway merge: user screenshot + CSV indicate blocked at WP2538 after reported merge completion; rear-left is ignored from WP2538-2560, while LEFT9293 remains safety gate. Second merge WP3050-3190 keeps rear-left active; actual second completion WP not known. This is a waypoint assumption, not verified lane geometry. No time-based automatic creep if side lane is unsafe.
merge.speed_note: Highway merge SAFE/yellow no longer imposes 20kmh; existing V7 curvature, traffic, LiDAR, pedestrian and highway following restrictions remain. Roundabout WP1770-1820 still uses 20kmh cap and left-only risk.
merge.roundabout_completion_note: Provisional: only after actual STOP/vision-wait + 3 distinct safe camera packets + >=10 WP progress AND WP>=1800, roundabout merge camera is ignored until WP1820. This is not surveyed lane-clearance geometry; validate visually in MORAI before high-speed testing.
merge.prewarm_note: Enable side inference 70 waypoints (~35m at typical 0.5m spacing) before active zone; control remains restricted to active zones. Safe prewarm packets <=1s old are accepted at entry; missing/unsafe packets still stop.
merge.roundabout_left_camera_roi_note: Roundabout and roundabout_prearm ONLY: infer vehicles on the RIGHT half (original image x>=0.50*width) of LEFT UDP9293. Ignore left half. Highway LEFT/LEFT_REAR inference is full-frame, unchanged. Mask may miss an approaching roundabout vehicle, validate in supervised MORAI test.

static.note: Static local-avoidance speed target/cap: 25 km/h, only in the designated static mission WP590-760 or while a path started there remains latched. CLEAR follows the existing V7 profile (up to 57 km/h), traffic logic unchanged; STOP_REQUIRED or stale active sensor still brakes. Transition from 57 km/h at a 15 m obstacle trigger has not been validated.
static.zone_note: Provisional from Oct 28 run: designated static obstacle was avoided WP635-697; false avoidance WP862-921 and WP1270-1323. Confirm exact scenario start/end against MORAI before competition.

dynamic_pedestrian.zone_note: User-confirmed by manual MORAI waypoint survey: pedestrian/dynamic-obstacle mission WP720-1050. WP720-760 overlaps static-avoidance zone WP590-760; both safety constraints may apply in that overlap.
dynamic_pedestrian.note: Observe forward camera YOLO person(0) + MiDaS risk from provided script; stop in zone when risk>=0.50. No direct controls from vision worker. Fail stop on missing/stale results while active. Other detected COCO vehicle classes are display-only.

highway_follow.note: Frontend in-lane ROI from user code. Second WP3200-tollgate end is NOT specified: follow speed constraint remains through path end but 120kmh is DISABLED on segment 2 until verified tollgate_exit_wp. High-speed control requires explicit --max-speed 120 and MORAI staged validation; never calibrated TTC.
highway_follow.near_roi_note: Full-frame near-field trapezoid with overlap-based selection, hood crop 0.98 in follow mode; retains last close-vehicle risk for <=0.8s then fades by 1.6s. Not calibrated distance or collision prevention.

gps_shadow.notes: Based on provided morai_lanenet_viz.py HSV/Canny/BEV/EMA, not actual TensorFlow LaneNet. On GPS missing/unchanged for >1.0s while moving, camera lane steer is PRIMARY. Bounded IMU+speed dead reckoning is only for original LiDAR planner alignment and approximate WP gates, never for primary steering. Never continue blindly: no initial fix, stale lane, invalid lane, IMU/status failure, pose gap>0.8s, >12s or >35m blackout or >7m path offset => full stop. Full-vehicle dynamic traffic detection is NOT covered; existing pedestrian YOLO/MiDaS only.
